temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days despite normally being engaging; when Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is normally engaging and that her recent quietness is unusual, but she does not yet know the reason.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Carolyn learns Marilyn's quietness is explained by being overwhelmed at work and by personal issues, and that Marilyn appreciates the concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn is under significant work/personal stress but is willing to acknowledge it and values Carolyn's support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and keep the door open for Marilyn to talk if she wants.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn was curt in a subsequent interaction, which confused and hurt Carolyn; when Carolyn apologizes if she overstepped and shares her own tough times, Marilyn says she appreciates it, apologizes for seeming off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is overwhelmed by work/personal stress and appreciated her earlier concern, so the curtness feels unexpected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Carolyn initially wonders if she overstepped or if Marilyn is distancing herself, but Marilyn's explanation reframes the curtness as stress from a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn was not rejecting her; the curtness came from a hard week, and Marilyn is open to Carolyn's support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and slightly hurt, then reassured and sympathetic
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear any misunderstanding, show support, and avoid overstepping while remaining available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness; when Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful about a budding friendship with Marilyn after Marilyn's positive response to her openness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's acceptance confirms she is willing to socialize outside work, strengthening Carolyn's belief that the friendship is developing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn values the connection and is interested in building a friendship beyond work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the friendship by hosting the gathering and including Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still maintaining professional distance at the bank; when Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she didn't realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and suggests talking to improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she and Marilyn are becoming friends through positive outside-work interactions, so she expects warmth to carry into work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Carolyn is disappointed and confused by the perceived work distance, but Marilyn's response suggests the distance may be unintended and is open to improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes the work distance may be unintentional or a boundary issue they can discuss, and that Marilyn is willing to work on their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously reassured
temporal_state_chain.intention: To address the work dynamic directly, understand the distance, and improve collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn proposes teaming up on a new project; Marilyn agrees, says she is glad they had that talk, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she and Marilyn cleared the air in their private meeting and now better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms and strengthens Carolyn's belief that they have a mutually understood, collaborative partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes they share mutual understanding and are ready to work more closely together on the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
